body.condition: The critical order satisfies \(1\le m\le k-1\).

novel.justification: The index records the largest permitted vanishing order of the intervention-contrast derivative. Finite Fourier and periodic spline contrasts with controlled multiplicities furnish every value \(1\le m\le k-1\); the index is imposed for quantitative recovery and is not inferred from a Morse perturbation theorem.
